title: Bear cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' fill='none'>

  <polygon points='50,8 44,23 56,23' fill='#FFD93D'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='23' r='2' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='23' r='2' fill='#FF4D6D'/>

  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='10' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='6' fill='#C68B5E'/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='10' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='6' fill='#C68B5E'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='22' fill='#A0704A'/>

  <path d='M45 62 Q50 68 55 62' stroke='#3D2210' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#A0704A'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- Paw left -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='78' r='2' fill='#C68B5E'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='77' r='2' fill='#C68B5E'/>
  <!-- Paw right -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
